bounds: Illiquidity means you may not be able to turn an investment into cash when you want.
Private startup securities usually do not trade on an exchange with a continuous list of buyers.
In Reg CF, resale is generally restricted for the first year, subject to limited exceptions.
After that period, there is still no guarantee that anyone will buy your security, or that a transfer is allowed under the company’s documents.
A company may take years to have a sale, public listing, or other event that creates a possible payout.
For example, investing $1,000 does not mean you can request the $1,000 back next month.
Plan as though the money could be tied up indefinitely and could ultimately be lost.
Before investing, check transfer restrictions, any company approval requirements, and what events could create liquidity.
A reported valuation or a new funding round is not the same as cash you can withdraw.
